headline: Port St. Lucie launches free Lunch and Learn series on utilities and storm readiness
body:
Port St. Lucie's Utility Systems Department is launching a series of free quarterly Lunch and Learn sessions aimed at helping residents better understand the city's water, sewer and storm-readiness systems.

The four sessions will run from October 2026 through July 2027, with each program scheduled from noon to 1 p.m. at the Port St. Lucie Community Center, 2195 SE Airoso Blvd.

City utility staff and subject-matter experts will lead the sessions, covering topics ranging from preventing sewer problems caused by fats and oils to storm preparation and the history and future of Port St. Lucie's utility system.

The 2026-27 schedule includes:

- **Oct. 5, 2026: Cease the Grease** — How fats, rags, oils and grease affect the city's water and sewer system.
- **Jan. 26, 2027: Sewer Systems** — An overview of the different types of sewer systems in Port St. Lucie and recommended maintenance practices.
- **April 5, 2027: Storm Preparation and Recovery** — How the Utility Systems Department prepares for storms and responds afterward.
- **July 6, 2027: 100,000-Plus Connections** — A look at the history and future of Port St. Lucie's Utility Systems Department.

Registration is required for the sessions. Residents can sign up at [link.cityofpsl.com/usdll2627](https://link.cityofpsl.com/usdll2627).
teaser: Port St. Lucie will host four free Lunch and Learn sessions covering sewer systems, storm preparation, and other utility topics.
